title: RC-06 sibling: the dashboard re-reads MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS, MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE and DAILY_LOSS_PCT with its own copies of the parsers instead of asking the enforcing risk manager, so a malformed value that switches a limit off is shown as null or as the raw text, never as "limit off"

evidence.note: GET /limits: parseInt(process.env.MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS || "10"), parseFloat(MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE || "10.0"), parseFloat(DAILY_LOSS_PCT || "10"), re-read on every request
GET /chains riskLimits: the raw env strings with the same || defaults, no parsing at all
the enforcing copy: loadRiskConfig() once at import with the same parsers; a non-numeric value gives NaN and every comparison against it is false (limit off, AUD-DB-001 sub_claims 1-3)
NaN goes into res.json, which serializes NaN as null
positionPct = used / null -> Infinity (or NaN at 0 / null) -> clamped to 100 (a full red bar)
RiskGauge with max null -> pct 0 (an empty bar)

sibling_sites_checked: All env reads of risk limits in src/api (grep process.env over the snapshot): risk.ts:80-82 and chains.ts:88-90 only; the other dashboard numbers come from engine objects (chains.ts:83-85 ctx.chain, :93-96 exitConfig). The DB slice already records these two sites as RC-06 sub_claim 15 of AUD-DB-001 (the enforcement-side entry, card OD-25); MAX_POSITION_SIZE, SNIPE_COOLDOWN_MS and the per-chain max capital limits are enforced but not shown on the risk page. Threshold rows TH-API-04..06 (this slice) point at TH-DB-01..03.
severity_rationale: S3 (misleading display): the dashboard cannot show that a limit is switched off; it shows null, a full red bar, an empty bar or the raw text depending on the page. The enforcement defect itself is AUD-DB-001 (RC-06, S1, ESC-DB-01). MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS is fail-closed at boot (preflight), so that one cannot reach the dashboard malformed.
recommendation: Expose the effective, parsed limits from riskManager through one function and have both routes return those values plus an explicit "disabled/invalid" state; show every enforced limit (including position size, cooldown and per-chain capital). Decide together with OD-25 (one typed parser). Phase 29 unless Phase 24 folds it into OD-25.
